        if self.bias is not None:

        if self.bias is not None: self.bias = self.bias.cpu()

            out_tensors.get("suh"),
            out_tensors.get("svh"),
            out_tensors.get("trellis"),
            out_tensors.get("mcg"),
            out_tensors.get("mul1"),

                proto_svh = torch.randn((n,), dtype = torch.half, device = device)
